Title: MONTAGE TEST
Author: Test Writer

FADE IN:

.THE OLD WORKSHOP

Dust hangs in the air. Tools line the walls.

I/E TRAIN COMPARTMENT - MORNING
ANITA #2 sits by the window, sketchbook in her lap.

ANITA #2
(quietly, to herself)
Almost there.

> DISSOLVE TO:

INT. STATION PLATFORM - DAY
Crowds surge past. ANITA #2 steps off the train.

SATISH & DEEPA
(in unison)
Anita!

They wave from across the platform.

CUT TO:

EXT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT
The city glows below. SATISH lights a cigarette.

SATISH
(exhaling)
Some things never change.

FADE OUT.
